name: Paper: RL narrows the reasoning strategies of LLMs but raises Pass@1024
title: Paper: RL narrows the reasoning strategies of LLMs but raises Pass@1024
summary: The paper studies how reinforcement learning changes reasoning in Qwen3-14B. RL cut the diversity of solution strategies by about 18%, yet BoxNet Pass@1024 rose from 34% to 51%. The result goes against the common view that RL only sharpens what the base model could already do.
